thread:
maria: FYI starting an ownerless-admin sweep next Mon. Need to lock the decommission/offboard flow and make sure we can produce audit evidence for compliance reviews. pinging infra + SRE + legal for questions.
jon: +1. Quick q — can we auto-deactivate roles after 7d of no activity or do we need a manual handback? What's the risk if a deployment references the role?
eva: Watch out for KMS grants crossing projects. If we blindly remove bindings we'll break service-to-service keys. We should snapshot key IAM before removals.
sam: Agreed. Draft runbook idea: identify ownerless principals, create tickets, notify owners, wait X days, deactivate, collect audit evidence, escalate if needed. Short and testable.
maria: paste runbook please
sam: ```
# offboard runbook (draft)
# 1) query ownerless principals older than 90d
# 2) generate report and create triage ticket per principal
# 3) post notification to owner/team + 7d reply window
# 4) after 7d if no reply -> disable role binding (mark for removal)
# 5) snapshot IAM & KMS ACLs, collect logs, then remove
# 6) store evidence (sha256) in compliance bucket
query_ownerless --age=90d --format=csv > ownerless-90d.csv
for p in ownerless-90d.csv:
  create_ticket --assignee=oncall --desc "ownerless principal"
  post_slack_notice --channel=owners --principal=$p
  wait 7d
  if no_response: deactivate-role --principal $p
  gcloud logging read "resource.type=project AND protoPayload.methodName:BindRole" --limit 1000 > $p.bindings.log
```
jon: nit: add an explicit KMS export step `gcloud kms keys get-iam-policy` and snapshot any bucket/object policies that reference the role. Also add a canary for infra agents so deploys fail loudly if they reference a missing role.
eva: +1. Also add a recovery plan: if a deployment breaks, we should be able to quickly re-add a time-limited binding and notify the owning team.
sec-bot: IncidentBot: Created task INC-4888 "ownerless-admin sweep planning" assigned to maria, sam.
carla: legal: for audit evidence we prefer an immutable artifact with checksum and retention metadata. CSV + sha256-signed tarball is fine.
ops-oncall: Heads-up — we'll run a staging canary prune Wed 02:00 UTC. Expect a short window (5-10m) where infra-agent will reject absent-role ops. We'll monitor.
maria: Who owns KMS snapshotting? @eva? I want the command + proof saved to the ticket.
eva: I'll own snapshots and post checksum. sample command I'll run: ```
gcloud kms keys get-iam-policy projects/my-proj/locations/global/keyRings/ring/cryptoKeys/key --format=json > key-iam-4888.json
sha256sum key-iam-4888.json > key-iam-4888.sha256
```
maria: Perfect — please attach both files to INC-4888. Also add the bucket/object ACL snapshots.
sam: I'll update the runbook to include explicit export commands and the evidence upload step. PR incoming.
jon: I'll add a deploy-time guard flag to infra-agent (`--deny-absent-role`) and flip it in staging for the canary. Will post logs.
ops-oncall: We'll also enable extra tracing for the prune window and collect traces into /var/log/prune-canary for 48h.
carla: small note for compliance: include a short statement in the ticket that the artifact was hashed and stored; that'll satisfy auditors.
